page: Full-stack application on Cloudflare Workers with Vite using @cloudflare/vite-plugin. Recommended way for new Cloudflare projects. Features: fast Vite dev server, server-side rendering with Hono JSX, client-side scripts bundled by Vite. Setup: npm create hono@latest my-app, select cloudflare-workers+vite template. Install: npm i. Directory: public/ (static), src/index.tsx (server entry), src/renderer.tsx (layout), vite.config.ts, wrangler.jsonc. Configuration: vite.config.ts with cloudflare() and ssrPlugin(). Hello World: Hono app with c.render() JSX support. Renderer: jsxRenderer from hono/jsx-renderer with ViteClient, Link components. Run: npm run dev, access http://localhost:5173. Deploy: npm run deploy builds with Vite, publishes with Wrangler. Bindings: configure in wrangler.jsonc (vars, KV, D1). Type generation: npm run cf-typegen creates CloudflareBindings interface. Client-side: Script component from vite-ssr-components/hono pointing to client entry. Questions: How do I set up Cloudflare Workers + Vite? How do I configure bindings? How do I deploy? How do I add client scripts?

Development server. Command: npm run dev, yarn dev, pnpm dev, bun run dev. Access: http://localhost:5173. Fast Vite dev server. Questions: How do I run dev server? What's the URL?

Deployment to Cloudflare. Deploy script: npm run deploy, yarn deploy, pnpm run deploy, bun run deploy. Process: Vite builds, Wrangler publishes. Requirements: Cloudflare account. Questions: How do I deploy? What does the deploy script do?

Cloudflare Bindings configuration. File: wrangler.jsonc. Schema: $schema points to wrangler config-schema. Configuration: name, compatibility_date, main (src/index.tsx), vars section. Example variable: MY_NAME: "Hono". Type generation: npm run cf-typegen creates CloudflareBindings interface. Usage: new Hono<{ Bindings: CloudflareBindings }>(), access via c.env.MY_NAME. Questions: How do I configure variables? How do I generate types? How do I access bindings?

Client-side scripts with vite-ssr-components. Renderer imports Script, ViteClient from 'vite-ssr-components/hono'. Script component: <Script src='/src/client.ts' />. Vite handles bundling for dev and production. Placement: in renderer head. Benefits: unified Vite build system. Reference: @cloudflare/vite-plugin docs, vite-ssr-components repo.
